---LOANS
WITH TBL AS (

SELECT BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN.ACID,  MAX(BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL.END_EOD_DATE) AS LATEST_END_EOD
FROM BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN
INNER JOIN BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL ON BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN.ACID = BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL.ACID
WHERE CUST_ID = 'A3568554' AND
ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J')
GROUP BY BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN.ACID)

SELECT BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL.TRAN_DATE_BAL, TBL.ACID, TBL.LATEST_END_EOD
FROM BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL
INNER JOIN TBL ON BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL.ACID = TBL.ACID AND
BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL.END_EOD_DATE = TBL.LATEST_END_EOD
